shortcuts.action: Ask an agent to write a graph

Trust an untrusted graph (Trust… then Trust); continue an edge held at its round cap, else open the session of the step that needs you (else the running or start step); on a graph, run it with its input
Always allow a waiting step's command (asks first)

commands.title: Ask an agent to write a graph
commands.description: Start an agent session that asks you what roles and hand-offs the graph should have, then writes its file without running it, and show it in Agents.

commands.title: List agent graphs
commands.description: List the agent graphs in .clubmate/graphs/*.json of your worktree (else of the current worktree of each workspace folder; a repo's main checkout is not looked in from another worktree), the user's own graphs in ~/.clubmate/graphs/*.json shown in every workspace (user: true), the graphs built into Clubmate (builtin: true; a project file replaces a user or built-in graph of the same name, a user graph a built-in one) and this workspace's graph runs: {graphs: [{name, title?, description?, path, nodes, builtin?, user?, untrusted?, hash?, changed?, trusted?, error?}], runs: [{id, graph, title, status, reason?, turns, maxTurns, startedAt}]}. A graph whose file is invalid has error set. Non-destructive.

commands.title: Run agent graph
commands.description: Start a run of the agent graph .clubmate/graphs/<graph>.json, else of ~/.clubmate/graphs/<graph>.json, else of the built-in graph <graph> (see graphs.list): one idle agent session per agent node (your child sessions when you call it), one trigger per edge between agent nodes without maxFires (an edge with maxFires, like every edge of a step, is run by Clubmate itself: owned, no trigger); steps (nodes with run or command) are run by Clubmate itself after the edges into them and route by exit code, and a graph with steps fails untrusted until the user trusts it, then the start nodes get their prompt with input. The run stops itself when a node reports an outcome listed in its end, after the graph's maxTurns turns (default 20) or maxSteps steps (default 50), or when your session closes; graphs.stop stops it earlier. Sessions stay open after a run stops. Returns the run: {id, graph, title, number, builtin?, user?, status, reason?, turns, maxTurns, maxSteps, steps?, startedAt, nodes: [{id, role, start?, step?, session}], edges: [{from, to, on, outcome?, owned?, trigger?}]}. Watch nodes with agents.wait on their sessions and the run with graphs.show; graphs.delete removes a run from the list. Non-destructive.

graph.description: Graph name: the file name in .clubmate/graphs/ without .json, e.g. review-loop.

input.description: Task for the run, filled into {{input}} of the node prompts or appended to the start nodes' prompt; at most 16 KiB, must not contain {{.

commands.title: Show agent graph run
commands.description: Show one graph run with each node's session title and live status (agent nodes: running, waiting, done, idle, error, closed, gone, starting while the run's nodes start, or unknown when the session list failed; steps: not started, the step's status, or its outcome once finished): {id, graph, title, number, status, reason?, input?, turns, maxTurns, startedAt, stoppedAt?, nodes: [{id, role, start?, step?, session, title?, status, command?, outcomes?, end?, outcome?, durationMs?, startedAt?, last?, pending?}], edges: [{from, to, on, outcome?, trigger}]}. Non-destructive.

commands.title: Stop agent graph run
commands.description: Stop a graph run: mark it stopped, cancel its running steps, then delete its edge triggers so no node prompts another; a trigger that can't be deleted fails the call naming it, and stopping again retries. Running turns go on and the sessions stay open; cancel their turns with agents.cancel. An agent may stop only runs started by itself or its child sessions. Returns the run. Non-destructive.

commands.title: Answer a graph step's approval
commands.description: Answer a step of a graph run that waits for your approval: once runs it now, always (only for a step that runs in the main checkout) also adds the exact command as a Bash allow rule to the main checkout's .claude/settings.local.json, reject ends the step with error · rejected. Not for agents.

node.description: Id of the waiting step node.

commands.title: Continue a graph edge past its limit
commands.description: A graph edge with maxFires that reached its limit holds its next firing and the run waits for you; continue delivers that firing and allows the edge one more round. Not for agents.

edge.description: Index of the held edge in the graph's edges.

commands.title: Trust a graph's shell steps
commands.description: Trust the steps of a project, user or built-in graph as they are now: graphs.run refuses a graph whose steps (run, command, args, in, timeout, exits), routing or limits (maxTurns, maxSteps, agent nodes' branch, afk of a node a step runs in) changed since you last trusted them. Not for agents.

hash.description: The graph's hash as graphs.list showed it; trust is refused if the file changed since.

commands.title: Trusted agent graphs
commands.description: List the graphs in .clubmate/graphs/ of a folder, inside the workspace or not, that can run as they are now: their steps are trusted, or they have none. Returns {graphs: [name]}.

commands.title: Open agent graph run
commands.description: Select the run in the Graphs section and focus its detail; Triggers calls it for Open graph on a trigger a run created.

commands.title: Remove agent graph run
commands.description: Stop a graph run like graphs.stop and remove it from the list; a run whose triggers can't be deleted stays listed and the call fails. The sessions stay open. An agent may remove only runs started by itself or its child sessions. Non-destructive.
